about: Companies whose LinkedIn postings convert poorly for the owner's searches. Every scout run reads this file; a profile adds its own under companies.deprioritize. A match multiplies the score by `factor` and drops the priority one level (high -> medium -> low), with `note` shown as a red flag.

deprioritize.note: publica muitas vagas recorrentes e genéricas, muitas vezes para banco de talentos — chance baixa de ser uma vaga aberta de fato
